When a growing firm adds offices and its output stops looking the same

Borrowing-capacity scenarios across lender policies, with assessment buffers applied
AI voice agents for inbound and outbound calls that update the CRM

assets: The gold triangular A emblem around a blue orb, and the wide AURIXA SYSTEMS lockup
Deep navy and blue-black with metallic gold and selective cyan
Playfair Display headings over Inter body text
Layer labels LYR-01 to LYR-05 with SPEC // captions, each on its own layer (its offers name theirs)
The Compliance Passport seal: Issued · Current
The line 'Scale smarter through unified intelligence.'
Night-time high-rise offices lit by screens and warm gold edges
The call to action 'Book Your Free Demo'
guardrails: Word security exactly: Aurixa runs on infrastructure with independently assessed SOC 2 Type II controls and ISO 27001:2022 certification; never 'SOC 2 certified', 'SOC 2 compliant' or 'SOC 2 Enterprise Security'

Modelled figures (borrowing capacity, cash flow) show 'Illustrative example only: hypothetical client, figures and assumptions. Not a credit assessment or financial advice' and key assumptions; public statistics show source and date
Never say Aurixa makes a firm compliant or is endorsed by AUSTRAC, ASIC or APRA: it helps a firm run and record its own process, and the firm stays responsible
Never say a shared Compliance Passport lets another business skip its own checks: reliance follows AUSTRAC's rules and each firm's own program
No absolutes or performance numbers until substantiated: not 'zero bottlenecks', '100% conversion lift', '10x output', 'eliminates human error', 'absolute compliance' or 'patented'
Speak to the professional, never the borrower or investor: never say how much someone can borrow, that they'll be approved, or what to buy
Describe the AI exactly (drafts, extracts, flags, calls) and that a person reviews it; the voice agent says it is an AI assistant
Product shots are the real Command Centre on synthetic data; mock-ups are labelled 'Concept'; never real client data on screen
Waitlist and demos as they are: 'Apply for priority access'; joining the waitlist doesn't guarantee immediate access; label pre-release features
Label AI presenters and realistic AI scenes, and never present an AI person as a client, adviser, broker or expert
Regulatory facts dated and calm (AML/CTF tranche 2 has applied since 1 July 2026): no fear tactics or penalty figures
Use the calm, exact voice of the Compliance Passport and Builders pages, not the 'dominance' register ('weaponizing data', 'apex players'), with Australian spelling

beats.show: The real interface, zooming to each step until the result appears; every figure carries the illustrative-example label
beats.say: Captions name each step in a few words

beats.label: The result
beats.job: Land the result without a performance claim
beats.show: The finished output: a white-label brief, a scenario, a Passport milestone
beats.say: Caption: what is now ready

beats.label: Call to action

A screen recording of the current build on synthetic data; label anything pre-release
Captions carry it: it must work with the sound off
The brand in the first two seconds
